subject: Conditional colors in labels and nodes

messages.author: 409f5eb3bc5a4314
messages.subject: Conditional colors in labels and nodes
parts:
Hello, I have just started working with ggtree and a question has arisen. I have checked this forum and although I have found solutions that fit my problem, I have not been able to apply it correctly. I would like that in my dendrogram only the labels of certain nodes appear. I would also like to colour these nodes and some other species in a different colour. When I use my code, only the first species (Ceratop_sp) is coloured and I would like all four species included in the code to be coloured. 

I cannot share my data, but this is the code I Have been using
 q <- ggplot(phy_1, aes(x, y)) + geom_tree() + theme_tree() + geom_nodelab(size=2, nudge_x = -0.009, nudge_y = 1.6, vjust=2.5) + xlim(0, 0.5) + geom_tiplab(aes(color=grepl(c("Ceratop_sp", "Anophelinae", "Cloeon_sp", "Sympecma_fus" ), label))

The nodes i want to be coloured are called "n23", "n17", "n45".

Thank you in advance

messages.author: 48f5ec8bf2672921
messages.subject: Re: Conditional colors in labels and nodes
parts:
I guess you want to do like this.

> library(ggtree)
Bioconductor version 3.12 (BiocManager 1.30.12), ?BiocManager::install for help
ggtree v2.4.2  For help: https://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/

If you use ggtree in published research, please cite the most appropriate paper(s):

1. Guangchuang Yu. Using ggtree to visualize data on tree-like structures. Current Protocols in Bioinformatics, 2020, 69:e96. doi:10.1002/cpbi.96
2. Guangchuang Yu, Tommy Tsan-Yuk Lam, Huachen Zhu, Yi Guan. Two methods for mapping and visualizing associated data on phylogeny using ggtree. Molecular Biology and Evolution 2018, 35(12):3041-3043. doi:10.1093
/molbev/msy194
3. Guangchuang Yu, David Smith, Huachen Zhu, Yi Guan, Tommy Tsan-Yuk Lam. ggtree: an R package for visualization and annotation of phylogenetic trees with their covariates and other associated data. Methods in E
cology and Evolution 2017, 8(1):28-36. doi:10.1111/2041-210X.12628

> set.seed(123)
> tr <- rtree(20)

> ggtree(tr) + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=c(label %in% c("t1", "t8", "t18")), color=label)) + geom_tiplab(aes(subset=c(!label %in% c("t1", "t8", "t18"))))

​
